description: **A candidate UNSAFE program, §F19’s fourth door.** `Judge.iterClosPass` types `arr.map(&p)` by typing the closure’s body, `bodyResult` and all. Passing a **proc** whose body is `return e` is the same escape one call deeper. This one needs no change to `iterClosPass`: with `procRetOk` in place, a `proc { return e }` has no `Ty.clos` at all, so the `&p` premise cannot be met — and a `&lambda` with a `return` body stays sound, since there the `return` really is the block’s value.
sorbet_note: Expected `Integer` but found `String("s")` for method result type
